basic_info.description: Welcome to 849 Noe Street #5, where classic mid-century architecture meets modern elegance. Situated on the top floor of a charming six-unit building, this beautifully remodeled 1-bedrm 1-bath Tenancy In Common (TIC) offers a unique opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco's vibrant Noe Valley neighborhood. As you step inside, you'll be greeted by maximum natural light and a welcoming ambiance. The living area has large windows facing north. The modern kitchen is a chef's delight, featuring high-end Bertazzoni stainless steel appliances & custom cabinetry. The bedroom is a tranquil oasis, boasting ample closet space & western views of Sutro Tower, making it a perfect sanctuary at the end of the day. The stylish bathroom is meticulously designed with contemporary fixtures and finishes, including in-unit laundry in the bathroom. Additional highlights include hardwood floors and a dedicated parking space with a Tesla charger, plus 2 storage areas. Located equidistant between Noe Valley and The Castro, you'll enjoy easy access to an array of local amenities, including trendy cafes, boutique shops, and beautiful parks.
